hero.title: How brands use an AI agent to keep up during launches.
hero.body: Launches bring a rush of questions in DMs. Steps AI answers stock, shipping and size questions as they come in, so the team is not sitting in the inbox all day.

stories.attribution: Nina Kapoor | E-commerce Lead | Sunday Form
stories.excerpt: Our Instagram inbox used to be a mess during launches. People asking if something was still in stock, when it would ship, whether we had another size. Now most of those questions get answered without someone from our team sitting in DMs all day.

capabilities.title: What the AI marketing agent does.

items.title: Turn comments into conversations
items.body: Reply to Instagram comments with a DM when someone uses a keyword such as PRICE or LINK.

items.title: Send WhatsApp campaigns
items.body: Send personalised WhatsApp broadcasts, and replies come back to your agent.

items.title: Answer launch questions in DMs
items.body: Stock, shipping and size questions get an answer while interest is high.
